newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SPECIAL COMMISSION IN DEAL ON NEW DRAFT LAW.
newsitem.headline: SPECIAL COMMISSION IN DEAL ON NEW DRAFT LAW.

text.p: The special commission reviewing allegations that Deputy Prime Minister Elio Di Rupo had sex with under-age boys agreed late on Wednesday the draft of a new law short-circuiting the slow process of investigating a minister.

Members of the commission told Reuters that the new law, which allows the Cour de Cassation to investigate allegations against a minister without having to refer to the parliament, would be voted on by the full parliament on December 19.
They added that Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene and chief public prosecutor Eliane Lieckendael had both seen and approved the draft.

The commission is still faced with the problem of what to do about the outstanding allegations against Di Rupo, with the 11 members still deeply divided over whether to declare the number two in the Belgian government innocent or to press for further investigations. The meeting continues.
